system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction mechanism or prompt file available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
Identification of candidate files from the repository, uti-
lizing RAG and a Repository File Level Map.
env_context_strategy.note: Embedding RAG (Jina code embeddings) plus injected file-tree map and file schematic map; no agent navigation. Closest value mixed (embedding_rag + file_tree_summary).

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history-processing place available. Pipeline uses discrete LLM calls rather than a growing history.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The CoderParser Module performs a
comprehensive analysis, outputting both the precise location
and a detailed plan
observation_format.note: Inputs are code text, file maps, test failure info; inferred from prose.

tool_call_format.note: No tool-call parser described; pipeline stages with structured outputs, not tool calls.

tool_count.note: Fixed pipeline; no tool list exposed to the model is described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
For method or function-level changes, the AST module in
Python is utilized to replace the entire method or function
body.
edit_primitive.note: Top-level edits replace a start/end line range.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list or source to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each step in this process involves a discrete LLM call.
loop_primitives.note: k temperature-varied candidates with LLM selection (Sec. III.B.1); test feedback refinement (Sec. III.C). Paper explicitly prefers this over ReAct.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
This module operates based on the action
plan provided by the CodeParser module, processing each plan
element sequentially.
planning_granularity.note: Plan elements produced by CodeParser and iterated; storage format not specified.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
This LLM invocation
is executed iteratively for each plan element generated by the
CodeParser module.
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialised LLM modules (QueryGeneration, FileLocater, PreAssimilator, CodeParser, CodeGeneration) in fixed hand-off; could be viewed as single fixed pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation mechanism described; modules are pipeline stages.

human_in_loop.note: Paper does not discuss human gating.

long_term_memory.note: Per-codebase vector store is retrieval index, not cross-run memory; no evidence of memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Each solution under-
goes evaluation against the full suite of repository-level test
cases, rather than a subset
self_verification.note: Additional LLM call selects optimal solution among survivors.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
we have implemented a
constraint limiting it to a single iteration to optimize token
usage and computational efficiency.
retry_policy.note: k candidates plus one refinement iteration after regression failures.

termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends after stages; no termination conditions described.

cost_controls.note: Only refinement cap to optimize token usage mentioned.

eval_hooks.note: Evaluated on SWE-bench Lite, but no repo to determine whether runner ships.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
it allows for fully autonomous coding, par-
ticularly in Python.

open_source.note: No repo_url in evidence; licence unknown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
specifically GPT-
4 and Claude Sonnet 3.5, for code generation and analysis
tasks
model_agnostic.note: Uses two vendors; abstraction layer not described.
